source_text.body:
Prep fantasy football drafts with parallel research agents
A Claude Code skill runs parallel agents researching rankings, injuries, matchups and ADP for draft, weekly matchups and trades, producing a .docx report.
·
Nov 18, 2026
Done with
CC
Claude Code
What they did
Jason Horne turned his manual multi-tool workflow (NotebookLM, ChatGPT, Claude, a spreadsheet) into one Claude Code skill. In draft prep, four parallel agents use WebSearch and WebFetch to research rankings, injuries, matchups and analytics. Results are cross-checked for confidence and contradictions. A JSON config, edited once, holds league and roster details.
How it went
It produces a .docx with tiered rankings, round-by-round strategy, sleepers and players to avoid. The old workflow took about three hours of active setup per season. The post gives no measured results for the skill itself.
Worth knowing
He ran the manual version dozens of times first to learn which agents were needed, so test the workflow by hand before automating it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude Code
Copy prompt
Create a skill that runs parallel research agents on player rankings, injuries, matchups, and ADP for my [league format, number of teams] fantasy football league. Use it to prepare my draft with [draft position], then output a .docx report with tiered targets and sleepers. Finish when the report is saved and summarized.
Original source: https://blog.jasonhorne.org/blog/multi-ai-to-single-command-ff/
